items.author: bensig
items.context: Ben Sigman: Bitcoin está a 0,44x del precio del power law, bajo la banda roja inferior de su gráfico; señala que históricamente pasa poco tiempo ahí (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: Below the lower band is rare, but rare isn't the same as impossible to stay in for a while. I treat the bands as a map of where $BTC has been, not a timer. I laid out the model and its limits here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279

items.author: lil_disruptor
items.context: Jessica Gonzales: Blockstream (Adam Back) lanza con Thales un sistema de custodia institucional de Bitcoin con firma totalmente offline; Back dice que hace falta cold storage más simple porque la IA y los protocolos complejos elevan el riesgo de hackeo.
items.suggested_text: Offline signing being the selling point for institutions says a lot. The same principle works for individuals without a vendor in the middle: I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup step by step: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: KookCapitalLLC
items.context: kook: sostiene que $BTC hará piso mientras la Fed siga subiendo tasas (los dos últimos bear markets terminaron con tasas al alza), que toque fondo antes de la subida de diciembre y corra a $163k (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: Two past bear markets ending during hikes is an interesting pattern, but two data points is a thin base for a $163k target. The part I'd watch for $BTC is whether it holds the 200W while the hike gets priced in.

items.author: Sykodelic_
items.context: Sykodelic: Bitcoin perdió todas las medias móviles recuperadas (92 días de recuperación a pérdida, vs 719 la vez anterior más corta); igual cree que el piso está asegurado por su estructura de RSI semanal, espera soporte fuerte en la media de 200 semanas y un rebote contratendencia pronto.
items.suggested_text: Appreciate the honesty on the call that didn't play out. Losing every MA in 92 days is new territory, so for me the 200W is the line that matters now: hold it on weekly closes and the structure stands; lose it and 2022 is the only precedent for $BTC.
